exposure: depression during the first trimester of pregnancy
cohort: 519 pregnant women older than 35 years at conception
finding: While anemia was not significantly associated with postpartum depression overall, moderate and severe anemia was associated with a higher incidence of postpartum depression, preterm delivery, prolonged labor, and cesarean section in pregnant women older than 35 years.
mod_finding: Moderate and severe anemia was associated with a higher rate of Cesarean section compared to mild anemia (40.1% vs. 20.8%, P=0.002).
